biggest_catch: The $250 annual fee eats the bonus. Year-one net math: 85,000 Marriott Bonvoy points are worth roughly $595 in hotel value (at ~0.7 cents per point), minus the $250 fee = about $345 net — and $0 if you don't actually stay at Marriott hotels. Never spend $4,000 you weren't already going to spend just to chase this.
catches: Only claim a bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend that money — never spend $4,000 extra just to chase the bonus; only purchases count.
The $250 annual fee eats the bonus: 85,000 points (~$595 hotel value) minus $250 = roughly $345 net in year one. Points are worth $0 if you never stay at Marriott properties.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry on your credit report.
Carrying a balance at the card's 19.24%-27.74% variable APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay the statement balance in full every month.

Marriott's eligibility web is the real trap: you are likely INELIGIBLE for this bonus if you currently hold (or recently held / recently earned a bonus on) certain Amex Marriott cards (Bonvoy Brilliant, Bevy, Business) within the lookback windows, or if you currently hold a Chase Bonvoy Boundless or Bold — confirm on your offer details before applying.
Chase's 5/24 application policy applies (5+ cards opened across banks in 24 months typically = denial).

steps: Go to the official Chase page https://creditcards.chase.com/travel-credit-cards/marriott-bonvoy/bountiful and confirm the current new-cardmember offer, the $250 annual fee, and the offer-details eligibility footnote before applying.
Confirm you are eligible: no disqualifying Amex Marriott cards held or bonused within the lookback windows, and no currently-held Chase Bonvoy Boundless/Bold.
Apply online and get approved (expect a hard credit inquiry).
Within the first 3 months from account opening, spend $4,000 on purchases you were ALREADY going to make. Do not spend extra to chase it.
Pay the statement balance in full every month — at 19.24%-27.74% APR, a carried balance eats the bonus fast.
Watch your Marriott Bonvoy account after you qualify; points post after qualifying purchases — allow up to 8 weeks, then call if missing.
